answer_1.quote: We evaluate encoder-decoder models on a selected set of generative tasks from the ARGEN benchmark: Text Summarization (TS), Question Generation (QG), and Question Answering (QA)... In addition, we experiment on a single-turn dialogue task using the Empathetic Dialogue (EMD) dataset.
answer_1.outputs: generated text (summaries, questions, answers, dialogue responses)

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE to evaluate models on the TS task and BLEU for QA, QG and EMD tasks.

answer_4.quote: Each of the three models' outputs was evaluated by four annotators. We asked the annotators to label a hundred outputs from each model and each task for two scenarios: (1) Acceptable... (2) Best...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled each output as Acceptable (whether it is acceptable) and selected the Best output among the three models for each instance.
